arxiv-2106-05322.title: The diagonal cycle Euler system for GL 2 × GL 2 {\rm GL}_{2}\times{\rm GL}_{2}
arxiv-2106-05322.creator: Raúl Alonso, Francesc Castella, and Óscar Rivero
arxiv-2106-05322.description: Abstract . We construct an anticyclotomic Euler system for the Rankin–Selberg convolutions of two modular forms, using p p -adic families of generalized Gross–Kudla–Schoen diagonal cycles. As applications of this construction, we prove new results on the Bloch–Kato conjecture in analytic ranks zero and one, and a divisibility towards an Iwasawa main conjecture.

arxiv-2210-17507.title: The effects of Time-Variable Absorption due to Gamma-Ray Bursts In Active Galactic Nuclei Accretion Disks 2022 The effects of Time-Variable Absorption due to Gamma-Ray Bursts In Active Galactic Nuclei Accretion Disks – 3
arxiv-2210-17507.creator: Michael Ray, Davide Lazzati, Rosalba Perna
arxiv-2210-17507.description: Abstract Both long and short gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) are expected to occur in the dense environments of active galactic nuclei (AGN) accretion disks. As these bursts propagate through the disks they live in, they photoionize the medium causing time-dependent opacity that results in transients with unique spectral evolution.

arxiv-2311-04020.title: Analyzing Film Adaptation through Narrative Alignment
arxiv-2311-04020.creator: Tanzir Pial, Shahreen Salim, Charuta Pethe, Allen Kim, Steven Skiena
arxiv-2311-04020.description: Abstract Novels are often adapted into feature films, but the differences between the two media usually require dropping sections of the source text from the movie script. Here we study this screen adaptation process by constructing narrative alignments using the Smith-Waterman local alignment algorithm coupled with SBERT embedding distance to quantify text similarity between scenes and book units.

arxiv-2403-01281.description: Abstract Research on video activity detection has primarily focused on identifying well-defined human activities in short video segments. The majority of the research on video activity recognition is focused on the development of large parameter systems that require training on large video datasets.

arxiv-2412-04060.title: Expand Heterogeneous Learning Systems with Selective Multi-Source Knowledge Fusion
arxiv-2412-04060.creator: Gaole Dai, Huatao Xu, Yifan Yang, Rui Tan, Mo Li
arxiv-2412-04060.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gaole Dai, Huatao Xu, Yifan Yang, Rui Tan, Mo Li. Expanding existing learning systems to provide high-quality customized models for more domains, such as new users, is challenged by the limited labeled data and the data and device heterogeneities. While knowledge distillation methods could overcome label scarcity and device heterogeneity, they assume the teachers are fully reliable and overlook the data heterogeneity, which prevents the direct adoption of existing models. To address this problem, this paper proposes a framework, HaT, to expand learning systems.

arxiv-2508-12283.title: How the cosmic voids contribute to stalling and quenching the giant galaxies on their surfaces
arxiv-2508-12283.creator: Jounghun Lee
arxiv-2508-12283.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jounghun Lee. We report a numerical discovery that the formations of cosmic voids are closely linked with the mechanism through which the giant galaxies on void surfaces establish elliptical shapes, redder colors, and lower specific star formation rates (sSFR). Identifying the voids from the TNG300-1 simulations via the Void-Finder algorithm [ 1 ] , we explore if and how the shapes of the TNG galaxies located on void surfaces are aligned with the directions toward the void centers.

pmc-10733116.description: Respiratory viral infection can lead to activation of sensory afferent nerves as indicated by the consequential sore throat, sneezing, coughing, and reflex secretions. pmc-11509356.creator: Xinjie Wang, Gen Wang
pmc-11509356.description: The locomotion mechanisms and structural characteristics of insects in nature offer new perspectives and solutions for designing miniature actuators.
